extDescription.message: See torrent activity on your Transmission server, start/stop/remove torrents, and add .torrent or magnet links with a choice of download folder.

welcomeHtml.message: Welcome! Enter the address of your Transmission server and press Test connection, then choose which folders torrents may be saved to.

hintHtml.message: Other Transmission settings (speed limits, queue, peers…) are changed in the Transmission web interface.

savedAfterTest.message: The server address is saved only after a successful test.

foldersHelpHtml.message: The add dialog only offers the folders listed here and preselects the default one (or the last one used, if none is marked).

optBadge.message: Show number of downloading torrents on the toolbar icon

optInterceptClicks.message: Open the add dialog when I click a .torrent or magnet link

optInterceptDownloads.message: Also catch .torrent files the browser starts downloading

optStartAdded.message: Start added torrents right away by default

langNote.message: Automatic uses the first supported language from your preferred languages in Edge settings.

permissionDenied.message: Permission for this address was not granted

noFoldersYet.message: No folders yet. Add one below.

defaultOnTitle.message: Preselected in the add dialog. Click to use the last used folder instead

setDefaultTitle.message: Preselect this folder in the add dialog

noFoldersAllowed.message: No folders allowed: the add dialog cannot add torrents until you add one.

fallbackHelp.message: You can download it with the browser instead (button below, or Ctrl+click the link on the page), then choose the downloaded file here.

fileAccessHintHtml.message: To have this happen automatically, turn on Allow access to file URLs for this extension: the dialog then reads the file Edge downloaded by itself.

orPressAdd.message: Or press Add to let Transmission try to download the link itself.

errSiteUnreachable.message: Could not connect to the site

errSiteNotTorrent.message: The site did not return a .torrent file (maybe a login page)

edgePaused.message: Edge paused the download. Resume it in Edge's downloads (Ctrl+J).

edgeAsksKeep.message: Edge is asking whether to keep the file. Choose “Keep” in Edge's downloads (Ctrl+J).

errReadFile.message: Could not read the downloaded file

waitingDownload.message: Waiting for Edge to finish the download…

errFileNotTorrent.message: The downloaded file is not a .torrent (maybe a login page)

savedAs.message: Edge saved it as $1. Choose that file below.

noDirsAllowed.message: No download folders are allowed yet.

errNoDownloadDir.message: Transmission did not report its download-dir

dirNotAllowed.message: This folder is not in the allowed list

alreadyAdded.message: This torrent is already in Transmission.

magnetType.message: Magnet link (file list appears after Transmission fetches metadata)

setupFirst.message: Set up your Transmission server first.

errNoAddress.message: Enter the address of your Transmission server

errBadAddress.message: That doesn't look like a valid address

errProtocol.message: Only http and https are supported

errAbsolute.message: Use a folder inside download-dir, not an absolute path

errDotDot.message: ".." is not allowed: folders must stay inside download-dir

errNotSetUp.message: Transmission server is not set up yet

badgeNotSetUp.message: Transmission: not set up yet. Open the extension's options.
